## Current stress disposition — 11 September 2026

Part of the private-launch proof under #216/#268. **The native caller migration is merged in PR #305; full stress diagnosis can resume.** The migrated 1,001-Product publication/export case now exposes a separate 120-second test-deadline failure; its later restore/export assertions remain unverified. [Exact reproduction and evidence](https://github.com/KeeprDigital/card-keepr/issues/253#issuecomment-5628853432). Routine validation #271 and tooling #272 are complete; their old failures do not block resumption.

Main `75c0ae5c962b6d908c1492a44e83d0ab3e36f491` (PR #305), schema 32: [resulting-main CI 34560474989](https://github.com/KeeprDigital/card-keepr/actions/runs/34560474989) passes all nine required jobs. Routine validation is green; extended journeys, full stress, accepted-tier capacity and live rollout remain separate evidence gates.

## Completed and historical evidence

- [x] Correct the stress entrypoint so expected ingestion files run and missing expected tests still fail.
- [x] Correct host-pacing diagnostics to use retained request identities and retain the independent-host assertions.
- [x] Obtain a bounded manual workflow pass: [34416176363](https://github.com/KeeprDigital/card-keepr/actions/runs/34416176363), two tests in two files on `1894113c`. This predates the final tooling changes and is not a current-main/full-capacity pass.

The last complete full run retained in this ticket is [34336061374](https://github.com/KeeprDigital/card-keepr/actions/runs/34336061374): 16 passed / 3 failed. The two legacy reconciliation failures and the native 1,001-Product 15,000 ms elapsed-budget failure are preserved in the comments. Historical hosted timings are not measurements of today's code.

## Next work and remaining acceptance

- [ ] Using the native callers merged in #305, inventory and run the intended full current selection through `pnpm run test:stress:full`; current main contains ten stress files, including native 128-image coverage. Correct the stale nine-file runbook description.
- [ ] Diagnose the migrated 1,001-Product publication/export case that exceeds its unchanged 120-second test deadline. Preserve every behavioral assertion and obtain a completed restore/export result. Keep this separate from the existing candidate performance assertion below.
- [ ] Remeasure the native 1,001-Product result on the current runtime and diagnose any failure. Keep the existing 15,000 ms performance assertion distinct from test-harness deadlines and from CPU/billing claims; do not inflate it to mask the historical failure.
- [ ] Record every complete-run failure and its disposition. Coordinate usable capacity with #275 and uncovered durable faults with #276 without duplicating ownership.
- [ ] Obtain successful full manual workflow execution (`suite: full`) on the final code/runtime, plus current bounded scheduled/manual verification. A green default bounded run does not replace full stress.

The default weekly workflow runs two bounded pacing/throughput checks; full capacity experiments are explicit and separate. Their pass still does not certify the 5/50 GiB tiers, since the tier-admission probe fetches zero bodies. Keep this issue open until its remaining full-selection acceptance is met.

Use [the current testing policy](https://github.com/KeeprDigital/card-keepr/blob/e4d49f420e9cb3c0343ef54a9948720aadbdf146/docs/testing.md) and [stress operations](https://github.com/KeeprDigital/card-keepr/blob/e4d49f420e9cb3c0343ef54a9948720aadbdf146/docs/runbooks/scheduled-stress.md). Run heavy tests with exclusive measurement resources and retain exact SHAs. This reconciliation starts no workflow, capacity campaign or live operation. The issue title is unchanged because automated failure reporting finds this exact title.

<summary>Original scope and earlier checkpoint — historical; use the current acceptance above</summary>

## Implementation checkpoint — 9 September 2026
The entrypoint and API-coverage disposition are implemented in https://github.com/KeeprDigital/card-keepr/pull/277 (draft; merge pending). The package command now selects the existing ingestion stress suites directly and preserves missing-test failures.

Focused execution reaches `runtime-host-pacing.stress.spec.ts`, but line 43 fails: timestamp subtraction is `NaN`, expected at least 500 ms. The test expects request IDs `first-a`, `second-a`, `first-b`, and `second-b`; establish why their diagnostics are unavailable before drawing a production pacing conclusion. The complete stress selection and green scheduled/manual Actions run remain outstanding. Keep this issue open.

## Diagnosis — 9 September 2026
At main 51e1c83f, `npm run test:stress` first selects `apps/api/test/**/*.stress.spec.ts`; there are no such files. Vitest exits 1 with “No test files found,” so `&&` prevents all existing ingestion stress suites from running. This reproduced locally and matches the scheduled failure below.

## Acceptance
- [x] Explicitly run the intended stress suites and retain failure propagation when expected tests are absent.
- [x] Reconcile API performance coverage with current scope; avoid a blanket pass-with-no-tests setting.
- [ ] Run the intended suite to completion on the final code/runtime and record every remaining regression. Coordinate capacity/fault failures with #268 and suite reliability with #271 without duplicating evidence.
- [ ] Obtain a green scheduled or manually dispatched stress run before closing. A fixed entrypoint or one passing file alone is not full stress success.

## Original scheduled evidence
The `stress` workflow failed.

- Run: https://github.com/KeeprDigital/card-keepr/actions/runs/34100293889
- Trigger: `schedule`
- Commit: `cf6967fb7e1bc8fc407fc4eaff1c08c4538e00e4`

Inspect the run log, fix or file the regression, then close this issue. See `docs/runbooks/scheduled-stress.md`.

</details>
